title: Feature Puzzles: Single-Image Supervision for Multi-View 3D-Aware Segmentation
abstract: Humans can easily recognize the same objects across different viewpoints of a 3D scene, whereas teaching models such multi-view-consistent perception typically requires videos or calibrated multi-view captures, which are considerably more expensive and less diverse than large-scale monocular data.~In this paper, we introduce Feature Puzzles, a novel framework for learning multi-view-consistent segmentation using only single-image semantic segmentation supervision. Specifically, we propose a simple yet effective pipeline that constructs multi-view-consistent segmentation pseudo-labels through image cropping and geometric transformations. We further introduce a lightweight, plug-and-play network that leverages the multi-view-consistent image features learned by existing pretrained 3D foundation models and the generated pseudo-labels to perform multi-view-consistent segmentation. Importantly, our flexible framework supports various types of prompts provided from one or multiple views and can be readily extended to open-vocabulary 3D segmentation. Under this single-image supervision, our feed-forward model achieves the best mIoU on NVOS, remains competitive on SPIn-NeRF and ScanNet++ against baselines using per-scene optimization or in-domain multi-view training, and demonstrates zero-shot transfer to open-vocabulary 3D segmentation. Visual comparisons are available on our project page: https://featurepuzzles.github.io/

analysis.sourceNote: Full-text review of exact version 2611.05874v1, 21 pages, with visual inspection of key pages. All numerical results are author-reported and were not reproduced here. Implementation is promised; no working public implementation was confirmed.
analysis.ideaZh: Feature Puzzles把同一parent的mask/DINO field用已知crop映射传到多视图，再借预训练3D backbone传播语义。作者报告NVOS mIoU93.2%，但open-vocab主表用了GT geometry，248-view precision降到22.8%；要深读单图监督的边界，而非声称单图学出了3D。
analysis.motivationZh: 能否用已有单图mask和teacher features，为预训练3D表示补上跨view一致语义，而不收集多view语义标注？
analysis.methodZh: overlapping crops共享parent labels，late-block LoRA和多层features为promptable mask与dense feature两head提供输入；真实多视图3D先验来自VGGT-Ω，semantic finetuning不需真实多视图标注。
methodFlow: parent image一次生成mask/DINO teacher field
冻结早期3D backbone并适配late-block LoRA
geometry lifting与Talk2DINO分类或输出多view masks
analysis.experimentsZh: SA-1B task-specific mask/DINO supervision；NVOS、SPIn-NeRF、ScanNet++、nuScenes-mini；OV benchmark 11 ScanNet/4ScanNet++ scenes，0.02m voxel。 作者报告NVOS93.2mIoU，SPIn88.5落后MV-SAM92.9；ScanNet++63.60落后in-domain IGGT73.02。 (Tables 1–2, pp.7–8) 作者报告zero-shot ScanNet20070class mIoU13.79；in-domain闭集finetune47.79不能作为zero-shot。 (Table 3, p.8) 作者报告40→248views precision78.3→22.8；248frames32.11GB/16.68s。 (Fig.4, pp.8–9) 含per-scene3DGS/NeRF、SAM2/MV-SAM、IGGT与EmbodiedSplat；训练域和几何输入不完全同口径，不能只比总体最佳。 2500step短预算下LoRA和overlap curriculum影响较大，warp/consistency损失影响较小；No-Puzzles同时关跨view模块，有组合混杂，另给independent-view control。
analysis.insightZh: 已知shared-parent映射让语义监督一致，而非逐view独立teacher；N-view joint prediction区别于pairwise匹配。对照显示LoRA、featurefusion更重要，辅助consistency loss增益很小。
analysis.evidenceZh: 3D consistency继承预训练backbone；affine crops无parallax/disocclusion。 (Secs.1/3.2, pp.2–4; App.A.3, p.16); open-vocabulary精度在GT geometry下lift；speed为模型自身重建加semantics，两个口径不同。 (Sec.4.3, pp.7–8); 长view memory可承受不代表perception可靠，precision随view大幅下降。 (Fig.4, pp.8–9)
analysis.caveatZh: 长view absent-object false positives导致perceptual scalability受限。 affine crop exactness仅是合成监督一致，非真实3D correspondence；closed-set需与zero-shot分开。 GT geometry semantic结果不能当端到端reconstruction+segmentation精度。 point/box/mask已知prompt与long-range visibility评测不同；nuScenes低mIoU不能只用高SR宣传。 repo目前只有README，公开实现尚未提供。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 直接命中promptable/open-vocabulary 3D segmentation；shared-parent field构造对part representation训练有具体参考价值。
